availability_evidence: 当多个 API 使用相同的方法和路径时，可能会发生这种情况。HTML 和 Markdown 是通过 OpenAPI 数据转换导出的，OpenAPI 不支持多个 API 共享相同的方法和路径。

availability_evidence: By default, collection, environment, and global variable values are only available locally in your instance of Postman. The local value is used when sending requests, and it isn't synced to the Postman cloud. Update your local value as you'd like, without sharing it with your teammates. Learn how to [define a local value for your variables](/docs/use/send-requests/variables/define-variables/).

documents.title: Define variables in Postman
availability_evidence: Variable values are local by default and only available to you in your instance of Postman. These values aren't synced to the Postman cloud. Once you've defined a local value, you can optionally [share variable values](/docs/use/send-requests/variables/share-variables/), syncing the value to the Postman cloud.

In the request builder, you can create a variable without adding it to a variable scope. The value you enter for this variable is stored locally and is only available in the request it's set in. When you click ![Variable list icon](https://assets.postman.com/postman-docs/aether-icons/v12/icon-descriptive-variableList-stroke.svg#icon) **Variables**, the variable isn't associated with a scope (highlighted by color) in the variables pane under **Variables in request**.

Store secrets in Postman Vault
availability_evidence: * **Postman Shared Vault** - Store sensitive data as vault secrets in the Postman cloud. You can share secrets with your teammates in a Postman Shared Vault that's available at the workspace level. With your shared vault, you can share vault secrets with your team members across Postman apps and machines. Postman Shared Vault is available on Postman Solo, Team, and Enterprise plans. Learn how to [access your shared vault](/docs/use/postman-vault/postman-vault-key#postman-shared-vault).

* **Postman Vault integrations** - Create integrations between Postman Vault and external vaults. Link vault secrets in your Postman Local Vault to secrets stored in external vaults, which aren't synced to the Postman cloud. Postman supports integrations with 1Password, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, and HashiCorp Vault. Postman Vault integrations are available on Postman Enterprise plans with the Advanced Security Administration add-on. Learn more about [Postman Vault integrations](/docs/use/postman-vault/postman-vault-integrations/).

documents.title: Access Postman Vault
availability_evidence: > Postman Shared Vault is available on Postman Solo, Team, and Enterprise plans. To learn more about Postman plans, see [Postman pricing](https://www.postman.com/pricing/).

documents.title: Create and manage vault secrets in Postman Vault
availability_evidence: * **Create an integration** — Connect your local vault with an external vault provider, such as Azure Key Vault, to link and reuse managed secrets. Postman Vault integrations are available on Postman Enterprise plans with the Advanced Security Administration add-on. Learn more about [Postman Vault integrations](/docs/use/postman-vault/postman-vault-integrations/).

documents.title: Use vault secrets in Postman
availability_evidence: Try a vault secret in a request before adding it to your local vault. You can also create placeholder vault secrets to share with your API consumers. Your consumers can use placeholder vault secrets to add their own sensitive data. The value you enter is stored locally and only available in the request it's set in.

documents.title: Export and import vault secrets from your Postman Local Vault
availability_evidence: Since vault secrets are only available locally in your Postman Local Vault, they aren't preserved when you sign out of Postman, switch between the Postman desktop and web apps, or switch to a different machine. [Export your vault secrets](#export-vault-secrets) from your local vault to preserve them in a JSON file for later, either in encrypted or plaintext format.
